fields.label: Cash Account
fields.description: Main current account the forecast tracks (e.g. Banca Sella).

fields.label: Amex Account
fields.description: Credit card account; its cycle movements settle monthly against the cash account.

fields.label: Overdue Grace (days)
fields.description: Invoices overdue by more than this are treated as backlog to reconcile and excluded from the forecast. 0 keeps every overdue item.

fields.label: Amex Charge Day
fields.description: Day of month the Amex balance is debited from the cash account.

fields.label: Amex Cycle Day
fields.description: Cycle boundary: charges from day N of a month to day N-1 of the next settle together.

fields.label: Net Salary Account
fields.description: Account the monthly net salary is accrued on; the forecast projects its recent monthly average as a bonifico outflow.

fields.label: Payroll F24 Account
fields.description: Social security / withholding account (INPS, IRPEF); its recent monthly average is projected as the payroll F24 outflow.

fields.label: Payroll Lookback (months)
fields.description: Months of history averaged for the monthly payroll amounts. 0 disables the payroll forecast.
